title: FlexLine Limit Increases and Recent Draw Charges
content:
**Credit review note — FlexLine Personal Lines of Credit.** The draw-intensity share scales a limit increase by the draw charges posted on the line in the last 3 months, the draws and their draw-fee entries added up, measured against the current credit limit: 65% of it or more gives 0.80; 40% or more but less than 65% gives 0.90; less than 40% gives 1.00.

The share multiplies the increase before it is added to the current credit limit and the sum rounded down. The last 3 months take the entries dated after the same day of the month 3 months before the decision date.

| Draws plus draw fees in the last 3 months, against the current limit | Share |
|---|---|
| 65% or more | 0.80 |
| 40% to below 65% | 0.90 |
| below 40% | 1.00 |

*Hypothetical case on a 5000.00 USD limit:* draws of 3200.00 USD and draw fees of 64.00 USD give 3264.00 USD, which is 65.28%, so 0.80; draws of 2000.00 USD and fees of 40.00 USD give 2040.00 USD, 40.8%, so 0.90. An increase of 1500.00 USD at 0.90 becomes 1350.00 USD.
